text:
anya (content): Heads-up — prepping the SEO checklist for the webinar landing + post-launch blog. Need quick confirmation on redirects & internal linking plan. Goal: keep CTR high and avoid duplicate index issues. TL;DR: keyword targets, schema, canonical, redirects, inbound routing UTM.

tom (seo): +1. Can you share the final keyword seed? I’ll map priority pages and suggest 301 rules. :mag:

anya (content): seed attached in doc but main targets: "webinar integrations", "inference platform latency benchmarks", "hosted vs private inference". Also want structured data for Event + FAQ.

kate (web): For redirects — prefer single source CSV we can import to the deploy pipeline. Format: old_path,new_path,type,reason. I can run a preflight script.

ben (prod-marketing): Need the canonical for the landing page and the blog post that will link back. Also want a short anchor text list for internal links (3 CTAs).

nate (analytics): I’ll add a UTM schema for webinar emails and paid. Proposed: utm_source=webinar_email, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=2026_infer_launch. Will append to redirect targets where appropriate.

tom (seo): Quick canonical + redirect notes:
- landing page should canonical to /webinar/inference-launch (canonical rel)
- blog -> canonical to its own slug, then internal link to landing with anchor "Join the webinar"
- if old pages in /events/ or /docs/ exist, 301 -> landing. Avoid 302 for campaign redirects.

anya (content): Kate — can you draft the import CSV and drop in /deploy/redirects/ with the UTM appended? Example row below.

kate (web): Yep, I’ll drop it and run preflight.

-- code block --
/old-webinar-url,/webinar/inference-launch,301,consolidate-event?utm_source=webinar_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_infer_launch
-- end code block --

ben (prod-marketing): Also: schema snippets — Event + FAQ + breadcrumb. Small FAQ set (4 Qs) to help SERP sitelinks. I’ll write copy for those.

tom (seo): +schema recommendation: add structuredEvent.startDate (ISO), location:virtual, offers (free) and aggregateRating only if we have >5 reviews. Keep JSON-LD small to avoid render issues.

rachel (growth): Deadline: need preflight done by EOD tomorrow so we can hand to CRO for landing test. :clock10:

nate (analytics): I’ll confirm tracking and set up a test event in GA4. Ping me when CSV is in place so I can validate UTM landing triggers.

anya (content): Thanks all — I’ll consolidate and attach final keyword list + FAQ draft later today. @tom @kate @nate please react when you’ve done your pieces. :pray:

deploy-bot: Note: /deploy/redirects preflight job queued by kate. Job ID: dj-2026-27945. Logs available at https://deploy.internal/logs/dj-2026-27945

kate (web): Preflight passed locally, will push to staging in ~15m. :rocket:

tom (seo): Reviewed the draft redirects — one comment: change /docs/inference-benchmarks -> /blog/inference-benchmarks (keeps docs area clean). I’ll update the CSV before staging push.

rachel (growth): Amazing — once staging looks good we’ll run a small redirect smoke test with 50 visits. Everyone OK with that? :eyes:

ben (prod-marketing): Ok by me. I’ll coordinate the smoke test creative and auth for the test cohort.

anya (content): Cheers — moving this to final checklist. Will share the consolidated file in #marketing when staging is green. :white_check_mark:
